theme: An open Saturday before tomorrow's run to New York.
greeting: A wide-open Saturday, Dan — the calendar is empty until tomorrow's Sunday review and the flight to New York. Good hours to pack and to skim the board before you and Mike sit down at nine.

needsAttention.title: Skim the board before the 9 AM sync
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's Sunday review with Mike opens at 9, and the agenda is to give every board item an owner and a date. Worth a look at the Mike + Dan board tonight so nothing is cold in the morning.

needsAttention.title: Pack for tomorrow's New York trip
needsAttention.detail: You fly to New York tomorrow with a 6:45 dinner at Misi, and Delta check-in is already open. The 'organize small bags for travel' task has sat since the 17th — today is the day to clear it.

flagged.title: Google flagged a new-device sign-in
flagged.detail: A 'review your account settings' note tied to a new PC arrived yesterday — worth a glance to confirm it was you.

flagged.title: New LinkedIn connection request
flagged.detail: Dr. Romeo, founder and CEO at Lumorus, is waiting on a response to a connection request.

flagged.title: Chase Sapphire payment posted
flagged.detail: Chase confirmed your Sapphire card payment went through — informational, nothing owed.

flagged.title: New bulletin from Sarasota Memorial
flagged.detail: A news bulletin landed in your FollowMyHealth account; sign in when you have a moment to view it.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and travel promos — Company Store, Breeze, Mattress Firm, Airbnb, olive oil tins.
inbox.clear: Newsletters (FT, Bloomberg, Daily Italian) can wait for downtime.

resolved.title: NYC dinner is set
resolved.detail: The Sunday reservation at Misi is on the calendar for 6:45 — the P1 board task is effectively done.

resolved.title: Call with Martin Steindl locked in
resolved.detail: You replied and Martin confirmed; the call is set for Thursday the 27th at noon Eastern.

recipe.title: Tomatoes all dressed up for summer
recipe.why: Peak-season tomatoes are at their sweetest right now, so let them carry the plate.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — a genuinely open start.
Still clear; good hours to pack the small bags that have waited since the 17th.
A quiet close before tomorrow's board review and the flight to New York.
